result:
I fixed the audit warning. `PostController.store` now calls `Post.create(...)` instead of `forceCreate`, so `publishedAt` goes through mass-assignment filtering. `authorId` is passed separately from the session using `set`. `bun run typecheck` still passes, and `guren audit` no longer reports anything on `PostController`.

The audit still shows one failure and one warning. Both are dependency advisories, for `source-map-js` and `katex`, and neither is in a file I changed. I didn't touch them.
